column_classifications.BranchID: Identifier column representing the unique code for a branch office.
column_classifications.EmployeeID: Identifier column representing the unique identifier for an employee. Stored as float due to null values.
column_classifications.FirstName: PII column representing the first name of the employee.
column_classifications.Hiredate: Date column representing the date the employee was hired.
column_classifications.LastName: PII column representing the last name of the employee.
column_classifications.ManagerID: Identifier column representing the employee ID of the respective manager. Stored as float due to null values.
column_classifications.Position: Categorical column representing the job title or role of the employee within the organization.

notes: EmployeeID and ManagerID have null values and floating-point data types, which should be cleaned and cast to integers. Position contains obvious typographical inconsistencies (e.g., 'Manager', 'Manger', 'Manage') that require data standardization. ManagerID has a high null percentage (34.57%), which is typical for top-level executives or missing organizational hierarchy data.
